description: Fork of exp494 (softmax+temp penalty). temp_penalty 0.01->0.1 (10x). exp494 (lambda=0.01) drove T_sel to ~0.19 but argmax-hardening lost +0.073 bpb (not hardenable; soft win needs the blend). Stronger penalty pushes T_sel much lower to force a near-argmax-trained (hardenable) solution. Q: does soft bpb survive (sweet spot) or collapse to exp475-level? Run hardening_eval.py at end. vs exp493 1.4806 (soft), exp494 1.4804, exp475 1.4962, exp444 1.4821.
